notes.title: An Update on the Future
notes.content:
Hello players,

The outreach and support I received after announcing free to play was both inspiring and moving.

However, I have decided to meet each stance -- both positive and negative -- in the middle. The game will remain free on Itch.io, and Steam will provide players an opportunity to buy the "support" version, for which a future update will be coming. This content update will provide those who financially supported the game additional content as a thank you 

Free players are so, so are important to me as well, so while I deeply appreciate those who insisted I poise myself to have financial support, I am choosing to make that an entirely willing process.

To those who have purchased the Steam version and enjoyed themselves:
Rest assured, I have something special planned for you in-game with a coming update.

As for the future, I intend to undertake a journey in which I learn to draw and animate myself, as commissioning artwork can only get me so far on a limited budget. I will continue to support freelance artists as I always have, but it's clear that I need to be the change that people are requesting to see as well. I will be posting updates on my humble beginnings of an art journey, so I invite you to point and laugh along with me as I go from busted doodles to, hopefully, art that improves my projects forever.

More updates and projects to come, especially now that I have received so many kind messages. Thank you.

A dream of making games is no dream at all without people to play them.

Thank you and see you soon.
--MothOnMars

notes.title: Switching to Free to Play
notes.content:
Hello players,

First, I would like to immensely thank all of those who have shown this game support, both in my personal life and by purchasing the game.

If you have purchased the game and are still within Steam's refund period, feel free to submit for one (I have no control over whether or not refunds are issued, unfortunately. It is up to Steam.)

The game is currently free at https://mothonmars.itch.io/the-andere-realm-a-flicker-of-lust, but due to Steam's one week requirement to switch to free to play, this process will take until 12/10/24 (at the earliest -- I am filing the switch with Steam support).

Lastly, I would like to apologize who felt cheated by my work. Over 1,000 hours went into this game, as I wanted to create something that would outlive me in a genre I felt very passionate about after a rather large medical scare. I felt very emotionally attached to the older engine, as well as the world that I had created, and I understand that I failed to bring the expected level of quality to the game.

I will be taking a rather large step back from development, but any work to be released someday, you can find it at https://mothonmars.itch.io

Thank you.
--MothOnMars

notes.title: Moving Saves for ARAFL_S3
notes.content:
Hello players,

Today, an update went out to the game to fix some issues found by user NotMieseter in the postgame. With how SteamWorks handles the update, the entire directory was changed from ARAFL_S2 to ARAFL_S3.

However, for your existing saves, you can go to:
[Steam Games Directory] > steamapps > common > The Andere Realm A Flicker of Lust > ARAFL_S2
and copy the Save## (example: Save01) files found there to the new ARAFL_S3 directory, and resume your game.

Apologies for the inconvenience, as it stems from how updates to the depot are done for RPG Maker VX Ace, but you did not lose access to your saves, those files just need moved.

This will be a one-time issue, as I will be working on a solution to this problem before any further updates get pushed, should they be needed.

See you soon.
--MothOnMars

notes.title: Thank you
notes.content:
Hello player,

Publishing to Steam has been a dream of mine since the day I got my first personal Steam account many, many years ago. Further back still, publishing specifically an adult game has been a dream of mine since the day I first discovered them on a random, silly games website with an 18+ section.

Rest assured, many more games are coming. For Steam, that will generally mean finished, nearly finished, or at least a very large early access build. However, for early builds, or early access builds that may not have met my personal standards for posting to Steam, feel free to always see what I'm up to at https://mothonmars.itch.io/

I have been hard at work on the next game.

Thank you for everything.

--MothOnMars
